attrs.text: Mutation.addAuthEmail: Attach an auth email to a user (service admins only).

attrs.requirement: The system shall grant the `supporter` role (Can view and edit users and access Devadmin support functions.) the capabilities `CanViewUserIdentity`, `CanChangeUserData`.
attrs.title: Role: supporter

attrs.requirement: The system shall grant the `observer` role no capability.
attrs.title: Role: observer

attrs.requirement: The system shall send the secret web.GatewayToBackendSecret (backend_to_gateway_secret) in the `X-Ka-Gateway-Secret` header of the requests it makes.
attrs.title: Header contract: X-Ka-Gateway-Secret

attrs.requirement: IF `r.Header.Get("X-Ka-Gateway-Secret")` is `""`, THEN the system shall reject requests through `ValidateGraphqlSecretMiddleware` with the `StatusUnauthorized` error.
attrs.title: Access control: requests through `ValidateGraphqlSecretMiddleware`

attrs.requirement: IF `ctx.Secrets().Get(ctx, web.GatewayToBackendSecret)` fails OR `r.Header.Get("X-Ka-Gateway-Secret")` is not `expected`, THEN the system shall reject requests through `ValidateGraphqlSecretMiddleware` with the `StatusUnauthorized` error.
attrs.title: Access control: requests through `ValidateGraphqlSecretMiddleware` (2)

attrs.requirement: The system shall accept the `X-Ka-Gateway-Secret` header only when it matches the secret `web.GatewayToBackendSecret` (backend_to_gateway_secret).
attrs.title: Header contract: X-Ka-Gateway-Secret

attrs.requirement: The system shall accept the `serviceAdminQueryHeaderName` (X-Ka-Service-Admin-Query) header only when it matches the secret `ServiceAdminQuerySecret` (service_admin_query_secret).
attrs.title: Header contract: X-Ka-Service-Admin-Query

attrs.requirement: IF the caller is not logged in, THEN the system shall reject AIProfile.summary with the `Unauthorized` error.

attrs.requirement: IF the caller is not logged in, THEN the system shall reject Entity.findManyUserByKaids with the `Unauthorized` error.

attrs.requirement: IF the caller lacks permission `CanManageBlockList` for `acl.GlobalScope`, THEN the system shall reject Mutation.blockEmail with the `Unauthorized` error.
attrs.title: Access control: Mutation.blockEmail (via _blockEmail)

attrs.requirement: IF the caller is not logged in, THEN the system shall reject Mutation._unused with the `Unauthorized` error.

attrs.requirement: The system shall check access to Entity.findUserByKaid with `r.FindManyUserByKaids`.

attrs.title: Access control: Mutation.addAuthEmail

attrs.requirement: IF the caller is not the user `kaid` AND the request is not a service-admin query, THEN the system shall reject Mutation.addCoachRole with the `Unauthorized` error.

attrs.requirement: The system shall allow any caller to call Query.checkUsername.

attrs.title: Access control: Query.deviceAuthRequestInfo

attrs.requirement: IF the caller is not the user `user.Kaid` AND the caller lacks permission `CanViewUserIdentity` for the user `user.Kaid`, THEN the system shall return no data for User.pendingEmailVerifications.
attrs.title: Access control: User.pendingEmailVerifications

attrs.requirement: IF the caller lacks permission `CanChangeUserData` for any user OR (`customCheck(ktx)` holds AND the user `user.Kaid` is coached by the caller), THEN the system shall reject User.pendingEmailVerifications with the `NotAllowed` error.
attrs.title: Access control: User.pendingEmailVerifications (2)

attrs.requirement: IF `permissions.UserCanViewEmails(ctx, *user.Kaid)` does not hold, THEN the system shall return no data for User.emails.
attrs.title: Access control: User.emails

attrs.requirement: IF `err != nil` holds OR `canView` does not hold, THEN the system shall reject User.nickname with the `Unauthorized` error.
attrs.title: Access control: User.nickname

attrs.requirement: IF `acl.ActorHasPermissionErr(ctx, capabilities.CanViewUserIdentity, acl.AnyScope)` fails OR the caller lacks permission `CanViewUserIdentity` for any user, THEN the system shall reject User.nickname with the `Unauthorized` error.
attrs.title: Access control: User.nickname (2)

attrs.requirement: IF the request is not a service-admin query AND the caller is not the user `actor.Kaid`, the caller themselves (never true), THEN the system shall return no data for User.bio.
attrs.title: Access control: User.bio

attrs.requirement: IF `user.Kaid != nil` holds AND the caller is not logged in, THEN the system shall reject User.bio with the `Unauthorized` error.
attrs.title: Access control: User.bio (2)

attrs.requirement: IF `user.Kaid != nil` holds AND `ktx.RequestUser()` fails, THEN the system shall reject User.partner with the `Unauthorized` error.

attrs.requirement: The system shall limit User.notes to the `notes` that `permissions.VisibleNotes(ctx)` lets the caller see.

attrs.requirement: IF `_canEditDrafts(ctx)` fails, THEN the system shall reject User.drafts.
attrs.title: Access control: User.drafts

attrs.requirement: IF the caller exceeds the `Signup` rate limit by IP (200 requests per 600 seconds), THEN the system shall reject Mutation.signup.

attrs.requirement: IF the caller exceeds the `SignupAccount` rate limit by account (5 requests per 10 minutes), THEN the system shall reject Mutation.signup.
attrs.title: Rate limit: Mutation.signup (2)

attrs.requirement: The system shall allow any caller to call Query.serverTime.
attrs.title: Access control: Query.serverTime

attrs.requirement: IF the request is not a service-admin query AND the caller is not the user `user.Kaid`, THEN the system shall return no data for User.grants.

attrs.requirement: IF the caller lacks permission `CanEditDrafts` for any user, THEN the system shall reject User.avatar with the `Unauthorized` error.

attrs.requirement: IF the caller is not the user `kaid`, THEN the system shall reject that `kaid` of Mutation.merge with the `Unauthorized` error.

attrs.requirement: IF for some `kaid` in `kaids`, the user `kaid` is not coached by the caller, THEN the system shall return no data for User.peek.

attrs.requirement: IF the request is not a service-admin query AND the caller lacks permission `CanRosterDistrict` for any user AND the caller lacks permission `CanAccessDevadmin` for any user, THEN the system shall reject Mutation.roster with the `Unauthorized` error.

attrs.requirement: IF the request is not a service-admin query AND the caller is not the user `kaid`, the caller themselves (never true), THEN the system shall return no data for Query.tools.
